definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the lower leg to the foot. A technical/anatomical term used in medicine, physical therapy, and sports science.

examples.japanese: {足|そく}{関節|かんせつ}を{痛|いた}めた。
{足|そく}{関節|かんせつ}の{可動域|かどういき}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: The doctor examined the range of motion of the ankle joint.

examples.japanese: {捻挫|ねんざ}によって{足|そく}{関節|かんせつ}の{靭帯|じんたい}を{損傷|そんしょう}することがある。
examples.english: A sprain can sometimes damage the ligaments of the ankle joint.

notes:
The anatomical term for the ankle joint, used in medical and clinical contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {足首|あしくび}: ankle — the everyday word; refers to the ankle region as a whole rather than specifically the joint

USAGE:
- {足|そく}{関節|かんせつ}を{痛|いた}める: to injure the ankle joint
- {足|そく}{関節|かんせつ}の{捻挫|ねんざ}: an ankle (joint) sprain
- {足|そく}{関節|かんせつ}の{可動域|かどういき}: range of motion of the ankle joint
